newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine T-bill rate rises to 11.166 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippine T-bill rate rises to 11.166 percent.

text.p: The Philippine 91-day Treasury bill rate rose to 11.166 percent at its weekly auction on Monday from last week's 10.617 percent.
An earlier poll of financial institutions had expected the benchmark bill's rate to be higher at 11.375 percent.
The 182-day rate was 11.772 percent, up from 10.875 percent, while the 364-day rate was 12.255 versus 11.24 percent.
The total number of bids accepted was 4.5 billion pesos, compared to the total amount tendered of 23.26 billion.
